messages:
sam: Quick idea — add a shorthand command to the deploy bot that does pin + canary + auto-release-notes. Example `/deploy quick service=api version=20240312` that expands to canary 10% + pin. Thoughts?
nina: +1. Would be great for small infra rollouts. What's the safety default? :thumbsup:
axel: Needs defaults: canary 5-10% based on service, 15m watch, auto-rollback after failed health checks. Also enforce change-window for prod on-call teams.
sam: Example expansion I imagined:
```
/deploy quick service=api version=20240312
# expands to
/deploy run service=api version=20240312 --pin --canary=10% --canary-duration=15m --health-check=smoke --attach-release-notes=auto
```
nina: Release notes should include PR links + a "risk" field. Template suggestion:
```
summary: Short summary of change
pr: https://...
risk: low|medium|high
changelog: bullet list
rollback-plan: steps to revert
```
deploy-bot: @sam created shortcut "quick" for /deploy. Shortcut details: expands to pin+canary by default. Use `/deploy quick --no-pin` to skip pin. (automated)
ashley: One ask: make rollback explicit and discoverable: `/deploy rollback service=api --to=20240228 --reason="failed canary"` and have bot post a small checklist before executing.
axel: Also add a `--change-window` param, e.g. `--change-window="02:00-04:00 UTC"`. If omitted for high-risk services, bot should deny and ask to schedule.
sam: I'll draft a PR to add the shortcut + templates to deploy-bot today. Will include per-service defaults in a JSON config in the repo.
nina: Also add an eval hook that runs smoke and integration checks and posts results to thread. If smoke fails -> auto-rollback. :eyes:
sam: Thanks — I'll ping when PR is ready. small follow-up: should quick default to canary 10% or 5% for low-latency services?
axel: Lean 5% for high-traffic/low-latency services, 10% otherwise. Put per-service overrides in config.
deploy-bot: Note: Created issue #412 in releases-bot repo for "quick shortcut + release template" (https://git.company/repo/issues/412) and added the checklist template to /templates/releases. (automated)
